features.title: Sign up with email and password
acceptance: Open /sign-up while signed out
Enter a new unique email and a password of at least 6 characters, click Sign up
Land on /books signed in, with the header showing a Sign out button
Open /sign-up again and sign up with the same email: an error shows next to the form and no account is created
Submit with an empty email or a 5-character password: a validation error shows next to that field

features.title: Sign in and sign out from the header
acceptance: Sign up a new account, then click Sign out in the header: land on /sign-in
On /sign-in enter that email with a wrong password, click Sign in: see 'Invalid email or password' and stay on /sign-in
Enter the right password, click Sign in: land on /books with Sign out in the header
/sign-in links to /sign-up and /sign-up links to /sign-in

features.title: Signed-out visitors are sent to sign in
acceptance: While signed out, open /books: end up on /sign-in
Sign in from there: land on /books
While signed out, open / : end up on /sign-in; while signed in, open / : end up on /books

features.title: Empty shelf on /books
acceptance: Sign up a new account and open /books
See the heading 'My books', one sentence saying the shelf is empty, and an 'Add book' button
Click 'Add book': land on /books/new

features.title: Add a book
acceptance: Signed in, open /books/new: see Title, Author and Status fields; Status shows 'Want to read' by default
Enter title 'Middlemarch' and author 'George Eliot', leave Status, click Save
Land on /books and see 'Middlemarch' by 'George Eliot' with a 'Want to read' badge; the empty state is gone
Add another book choosing Status 'Reading': it shows a 'Reading' badge

features.title: Add-book validation errors next to the field
acceptance: On /books/new click Save with Title and Author empty: 'Title is required' shows next to Title and 'Author is required' next to Author, and no book is added
Enter a 201-character title: an error next to Title says it must be at most 200 characters
Enter a 121-character author: an error next to Author says it must be at most 120 characters
Fix both and Save: the book is added and shows on /books

features.title: Book list newest first with status badges
acceptance: Sign up a new account, add 'First Book' (Want to read), then 'Second Book' (Reading), then 'Third Book' (Finished)
On /books the order is Third Book, Second Book, First Book
Each row shows the title in the serif font, the author, and its badge: Finished, Reading, Want to read
At phone width (390px) the list is a single column with no horizontal scroll

features.title: I only see my own books
acceptance: Sign up account A and add a book with a unique title
Sign out, sign up account B, open /books: B sees the empty state and not A's book
Sign out, sign in as A: A's book is still listed

features.title: Book page at /books/<id>
acceptance: Signed in with one book, click its title on /books: land on /books/<id>
See the title as the page heading, the author, the status badge and a 'Back to my books' link
Click 'Back to my books': return to /books

features.title: Change a book's status; finishing records today's date
acceptance: On a 'Want to read' book's page, change Status to 'Reading' and save: the badge shows Reading, also on /books after reload
Change Status to 'Finished' and save: the page shows 'Finished on <today's date>'
Change Status back to 'Reading': the finish date is no longer shown

features.title: Rate a finished book 1 to 5 stars
acceptance: On a 'Reading' book's page there is no rating control
Mark it Finished: a 5-star rating control appears
Choose 4 stars and save: after reload the page shows 4 of 5 stars selected
Change to 2 stars and save: after reload it shows 2 of 5

features.title: Write a short review of a finished book
acceptance: On a 'Finished' book's page, type a review 'Loved the ending.' and save: after reload the review text is shown
Enter 2,001 characters and save: an error next to the review field says it must be at most 2,000 characters and the old review is kept
On a 'Want to read' book's page there is no review field

features.title: Filter the list by status with tabs kept in the URL
acceptance: Add one book of each status, open /books: tabs All, Want to read, Reading, Finished; All is selected and all three books show
Click 'Reading': the URL becomes /books?status=reading and only the Reading book shows
Reload the page: the Reading tab is still selected with the same single book
Open /books?status=finished directly: only the Finished book shows; click All: the URL is /books and all books show
A tab with no books shows a short 'No books here' message

features.title: Delete a book after confirming
acceptance: On a book's page click Delete: a dialog asks to confirm
Click Cancel: the dialog closes and the book is still there
Click Delete again and confirm: land on /books and the book is no longer listed, also after reload

features.title: Stats page: finished this year and average rating
acceptance: Sign up a new account and open /stats: see 'Books finished this year: 0' and 'Average rating: No ratings yet'
Finish two books today and rate them 4 and 5 stars, finish a third without a rating
Open /stats: see 'Books finished this year: 3' and 'Average rating: 4.5'
The header links to /stats and back to /books

features.title: Book not found page for missing or other users' books
acceptance: As account A add a book and note its /books/<id> URL
Sign out, sign in as account B and open that URL: see a 'Book not found' page with a link back to /books, served with HTTP status 404
Open /books/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000: the same 'Book not found' page with status 404

features.title: Fix: signed-in user sees the sign-in or sign-up form instead of their books
acceptance: Sign up a new account: land on /books with Sign out in the header
While signed in, open /sign-in: end up on /books, not the sign-in form
While signed in, open /sign-up: end up on /books, not the sign-up form
Click Sign out, then open /sign-in and /sign-up: each still shows its form

features.title: Edit a book's title and author from its page
acceptance: Signed in, add 'Midlemarch' by 'George Eliot' and open its page /books/<id>
Click Edit: Title and Author fields appear filled with the current values, with Save and Cancel buttons
Click Cancel: the fields close and the page still shows 'Midlemarch'
Click Edit, change the title to 'Middlemarch', click Save: the page heading shows 'Middlemarch', also after reload
Open /books: the list shows 'Middlemarch' by 'George Eliot' and no longer 'Midlemarch'

features.title: Edit-book validation errors next to the field
acceptance: On a book's page click Edit, clear Title and Author, click Save: 'Title is required' shows next to Title and 'Author is required' next to Author
Enter a 201-character title: an error next to Title says it must be at most 200 characters
Enter a 121-character author: an error next to Author says it must be at most 120 characters
Reload the page: the book still has its old title and author
Fix both and Save: the page and /books show the new values

features.title: Search my shelf by title or author, kept in the URL
acceptance: Sign up a new account and add 'Middlemarch' by 'George Eliot' (Finished), 'Silas Marner' by 'George Eliot' (Reading) and 'Emma' by 'Jane Austen' (Reading)
On /books type 'ELIO' in the search field and submit: the URL becomes /books?q=ELIO and only Middlemarch and Silas Marner show
Search 'march': only Middlemarch shows
Search 'eliot', then click the Reading tab: the URL keeps q=eliot with status=reading and only Silas Marner shows
Reload the page: the search field still shows 'eliot', the Reading tab is selected and only Silas Marner shows
Clear the search field and submit: the URL has no q and all Reading books show

features.title: Search with no matches offers to clear the search
acceptance: Signed in with at least one book, open /books?q=zzzz: one sentence says no books match 'zzzz' and a 'Clear search' link shows
Click 'Clear search': the URL is /books and all books show
Open /books?status=reading&q=zzzz and click 'Clear search': the URL is /books?status=reading and the Reading tab stays selected

features.title: Sort the list by newest, title or rating, kept in the URL
acceptance: Sign up a new account and add, in this order, 'Bravo' (Finished, rated 3), 'Alpha' (Finished, rated 5), 'Charlie' (Finished, no rating), 'Delta' (Reading)
Open /books: the sort control shows 'Newest added' and the order is Delta, Charlie, Alpha, Bravo
Choose 'Title A to Z': the URL has sort=title and the order is Alpha, Bravo, Charlie, Delta
Choose 'Highest rated': the URL has sort=rating and the order is Alpha, Bravo, then the unrated Delta and Charlie last
Click the Finished tab: the URL keeps sort=rating and the order is Alpha, Bravo, Charlie; reload keeps the tab, the sort and the order
Search 'a' with sort=rating: the URL keeps both q and sort, and the results are in rating order

features.title: Set a reading goal for this year on Stats
acceptance: Sign up a new account and open /stats: a sentence invites me to set a reading goal for this year, with a number field and a 'Set goal' button
Finish one book today, then on /stats enter 20 and click 'Set goal': see '1 of 20 books finished this year' and a progress bar at 5%
Reload /stats: the goal and progress are still shown
Enter 0, then 366, then 2.5 and submit each: an error next to the field says the goal must be a whole number from 1 to 365, and no goal is saved

features.title: Change this year's reading goal
acceptance: With a goal of 20 and one book finished this year, on /stats click 'Change goal': the number field shows 20
Enter 10 and save: see '1 of 10 books finished this year' and the progress bar at 10%, also after reload
Click 'Change goal', enter 366 and save: an error next to the field says the goal must be a whole number from 1 to 365, and after reload the goal is still 10
